source.provenance: Exact pinned Git blobs read as raw bytes with git show COMMIT:PATH through an explicit --source-repository CLI argument; no checkout conversion or newline normalization. Repository is a logical repo-relative marker, not a machine path. A minimal object store can verify these four paths without full history.

limitations: Developer verification map and static source checks only; no application runtime or persistence exercised.
Imported adapters, helpers, server handlers and route registration are outside the four pinned source files. Historical 16/16 export checks did not verify canonical Git blob hashes.
Independent acceptance belongs to original Claude reviewer through Root; this candidate is not self-approved.

states.summary: Quick Order advertises no account required; server session bootstrap precedes rendering. Checking, unavailable, blocked prior attempts and non-mixed mode suppress the form. Route registration and wrapper wiring are outside this snapshot.

Search, family filter and pagination show audience catalog entries. Exact variants can be added, quantity clamped and removed; up to 200 selections. Restrictions remain visible; links require one catalog-confirmed match.
Required legal name, email, phone, delivery address and adult confirmation; separate billing address when needed. Address validation precedes review; contact is held in component memory.

Request-only shell mounts existing agreement section and gates continuation on accepted, unblocked standing. Form additionally requires current versioned acknowledgments, including selection-dependent requirements.
Lists selected products, quantities and pending review type with contact summary. Edit selection resets acknowledgments. No guaranteed delivery date or final price is established.

Submission freezes validated input with an idempotency key, preserves an attempt marker before API submission and locks concurrent actions. Receipt displays saved reference pending review; no payment, prescription, treatment approval or shipping confirmation.

Uncertain reply retains frozen input and offers same-request retry. Only a known first prewrite refusal with a safely cleared marker resets the frozen attempt and acknowledgments; a later refusal cannot erase an earlier lost reply.

Restored marker replaces the form with a check action using its key. Unknown result retains attempt and advises support before replacement. Receipt appears only after confirmed recovery and safe marker clearing.

Checking/recovery renders no form; confirmed opaque owner keys remount on account switch, not token refresh. Form says only attempt marker is retained, not selections/contact. Shell clears customer state on definitive unauthentication/expiry; transient errors preserve recoverable work. Backend isolation is unverified.

Separate private readback component requests paginated queue and reference lookup; validates XRI reference and discards stale responses. Comment requires private staff shell and server Care authorization. Neither mount nor server enforcement is verified; no approve/pay/fulfill controls are represented.
